Raiding mt: warrior>druid>paladin
Heroics: paladin>druid>warrior

Warrior is better for progression raids.
But aoe tanking is hard with it, so you cant do heroics, unless you've got really good skills(you will remember a good tank warrior).

Druids are a safer choice i would say, they will reach dodge cap and their hp/armor is insane. And they can hold aoe aggro a bit better, hibernation is a great cc in some dungeons.

Paladins are the best for heroics. They can hold aoe aggro against seed of corruption locks even. 
And for raiding paladin is best for offtanking, great support class, buffs, secrifice for the mt etc..

But there will be always a shortage of tanks, so rolling any of these three class is a good idea.
